ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Hide Function from User
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry modifications that hide internal tools or functions from the user (malware like Agent Tesla, Hermetic Wiper uses this technique) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\HideClock$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\HideSCAHealth$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\HideSCANetwork$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\HideSCAPower$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\HideSCAVolume$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR ((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Explorer\\\\Advanced\\\\ShowInfoTip$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Explorer\\\\Advanced\\\\ShowCompColor$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)"))
